content.title: World Baseball Classic | Houston Astros
content.text: The World Baseball Classic is coming to Daikin Park in 2026!World Baseball Classic, Inc. (WBCI) announced the sixth installment of the World Baseball Classic, which is scheduled for March 2026, in which Daikin Park will serve as a World Baseball Classic host for the first time in the event’s history. The ballpark will become the ninth different Major League ballpark to host World Baseball Classic contests, joining Chase Field in Phoenix (2006, 2013, 2023); Petco Park in San Diego (2006, 2009, 2017); Angel Stadium in Anaheim (2006); Rogers Centre in Toronto (2009); Dolphin Stadium in Miami (2009); Dodger Stadium in Los Angeles (2009, 2017); Oracle Park in San Francisco (2013); and loanDepot park in Miami (2013, 2017, 2023).Dollar Dog Night - March 14thEnjoy Dollar Dogs during the Italy vs. Puerto Rico game on Saturday, March 14th. This offer is available while supplies last and is redeemable at all concession stands, excluding specialty stands. World Baseball Classic Fan ZoneJoin us early at Fan Zone before your game. Fan Zone is a fun, family event that opens two hours prior to first pitch for every game and runs through the start of each game. Fan Zone is a ticketed event only – fans must have a valid game ticket to enter Fan Zone for the corresponding game.Fan Zone Includes: Live Music Face Painters and Caricature Artists Inflatables Virtual Reality Baseball Photo Booths Special appearances* And More! Fan Zone HoursMarch 13 Quarterfinal 1 Fan Zone: 5:00pm – End of First Inning March 14 Quarterfinal 2 Fan Zone: 12:00pm – End of First Inning *Saturday's Fan Zone will feature a guest appearance and autograph session with former Astros player Jose Cruz.Food & Drink PassportTravel the world at Daikin Park with the World Baseball Classic Food & Drink Passport. Pick up your passport at Center Field near Hall of Fame Alley, visit specialty concessions featuring flavors from around the globe, and collect stamps as you go.
